description: Identify trading cards in a photo with the NeoSatoshi card recognition API. Games: Pokémon (default), One Piece, Disney Lorcana, Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG, Magic: The Gathering, Star Wars: Unlimited, Digimon Card Game (English, Japanese), Cyberpunk TCG (English, French) and Riftbound (English; French and Chinese prints recognized without a price), several cards per photo (binder pages work, one game per photo); football (soccer) cards with tcg "football" (Topps, Panini and other makers) and basketball cards with tcg "basketball" (NBA from Panini and Topps, mainly 2018-19 to 2026-27, and Panini EuroLeague from 2023-24; not WNBA, college, G League or NBL), several card fronts per photo (binder pages work, best up to about 20), max 4 MB. Returns per card: name, language, set, number, rarity, Cardmarket product ID, daily Cardmarket prices in EUR (TCGplayer USD where available), confidence and alternatives. Football and basketball cards instead: the player, release (set, number), season, subset, teams, rookie flag, a sure flag, alternatives and the parallel (three candidates with print runs, a pick only when the recognizer is sure; a person should confirm it). No prices and no images for them yet; it takes about 6 to 25 seconds. Digimon (tcg "digimon"): recognised by card number and name; alternative arts share the number, so the printing comes from the picture or stays open (print_unconfirmed) with the printings as alternatives. TCGplayer prices only for English Digimon printings. Older Digimon products (the 1999 card game, the 2000 trading cards) are not recognised. Cyberpunk TCG (tcg "cyberpunk"): Beta (Kickstarter) and Retail base cards share the same art, only the β before the number tells them apart (beta flag, print_id WNCB-132 vs WNC-132), and their prices differ a lot; when the photo cannot tell, the printing stays open (print_unconfirmed) with the printings as alternatives. The finish is fixed per printing (finish, is_foil). TCGplayer prices only for English Cyberpunk cards. Riftbound (tcg "riftbound", the League of Legends TCG by Riot Games): detection only, search_cards, get_card and correct_card do not cover it. The printing is the set code + printed number (print_id OGN-066, OGN-066a alternate art, OGN-299* signed; variant Overnumbered, Signature, Prize Wall or Best Of); when the photo cannot tell it, the printing stays open (print_unconfirmed, card_id rb-c-<card_key>, no price) with the printings as priced alternatives to pick yourself. Common and Uncommon exist normal and foil (finish says normal: take prices.cardmarket_foil and prices.tcgplayer.foil for a foil copy), Rare and above foil only. French and Chinese prints (rb-fr-..., rb-zh-...) have no price (review reason language_not_listed). Graded slabs (PSA, BGS, CGC, for football and basketball also SGC) fill graded with the grade read from the label. It does not grade card condition. Give exactly one image source: image_path (local .jpg/.jpeg/.png, max 12 MB, football and basketball 4 MB), image_url (public https URL, forwarded to the API) or image_base64. Uses the API key in NEOSATOSHI_API_KEY; without it, the public demo key is used (10 detections per day per network). One card usually takes about 4 seconds, about 10 to 12 seconds on the first request after a quiet period; with a progress token the cards are reported one by one while a binder page is read. include_images: true adds the catalog image of up to 10 recognised cards, to compare them with the photo.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded JPEG or PNG (max 12 MB, football and basketball 4 MB). A data:image/...;base64, prefix is accepted.

image_path.description: Path to a local JPEG or PNG file (max 12 MB, football and basketball 4 MB). Absolute paths work best; ~ is expanded.

image_url.description: Public https URL of a JPEG or PNG (max 12 MB). Sent to the API as is; this server does not download it.

include_images.description: Also return the catalog image of up to 10 recognised cards (small images from our CDN). Default false. Football and basketball cards have none.

tcg.description: Which game the photo shows. Default: pokemon. football for football (soccer) cards, basketball for basketball cards. riftbound for Riftbound (detection only).

name: recognize_cards
title: Recognize trading cards in a photo
